lines: d38: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Hazel Morelli is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d38: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d38: 🕯️ Hazel Morelli is dead — contest. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d38: What Hazel kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d38: "Hazel's gone." Eric looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Hazel." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d38: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Vera blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d38: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d38: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d38: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d38: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Hazel Morelli, 38 days. The mantle passes to Vera Cabrera.
d38: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Vera Cabrera, 24 — a lifeguard. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Bird Whisperer, Green Whisper.
d38: The village's quarrel was with Hazel — and Hazel is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d38: At the grave, Eric, Sam, Hagos and 3 more speak for Vera — "Hazel trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d38: The fire knew Vera before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d39: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d39: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d39: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d39: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Vera Cabrera, 39 days. The mantle passes to Eric Bautista.
d39: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Eric Bautista, 32 — an army medic. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Berserker Rage, Pyrokinesis.
d39: You knew Vera — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting them, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)

lastSay: d108: 📦 Your showbiz fans voted: a wacky curio, gift-wrapped, no note. The note would have explained it. There is no note.
d108: ◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from Thornfield bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
d108: Hagos Hailu reads the sky: rain tomorrow, freezing.
d108: Word with the traders: Emberhold door is clear again. Whatever had them, let go.
d108: Dawn. You wake rested. (+0 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
